create_bert_model: create a DummyBertModel instance with DummyBertConfig for encoder or decoder mode
build_bert_embeddings: build DummyBertEmbeddings with word, position, and token_type embeddings for input tokenization
test_bert_attention: test DummyBertSelfAttention and DummyBertCrossAttention with query, key, value projections and causal masking
refactor_bert_encoder: refactor DummyBertEncoder to stack DummyBertLayer modules with self-attention and optional cross-attention
run_bert_forward: run DummyBertModel forward pass with input_ids, attention_mask, and optional past_key_values for inference
